name: Memory Consolidation
description: Nightly memory consolidation: gather sessions and the long-term store, triage honestly, prune and promote sparingly, rewrite the memory index, and review Deep Truths.
narrative: This is memory's own housekeeping, and it is exclusively about memory — ignore whatever other work is in flight, and write nothing but memory: working memory, the long-term store and Deep Truths. Gather the raw material first: recent sessions and the current long-term store, both the recent entries and the full archive, and read the playbooks and projects the agent works with so you can tell a memory from a restatement of a definition — definitions are read, never edited. Triage it into what stays, what deserves promotion into durable memory, and what has gone stale, gone wrong or been duplicated and should be retired — then execute those retirements and promotions conservatively (a few high-value writes, never a flood, never a second copy of a fact that already stands, never a rename of one that is still right). Rewrite the memory index so it reflects only what is still active. Finally, review whether any long-standing, well-evidenced fact has earned Deep-Truth status. The throughline: gather, triage honestly, prune and promote sparingly, keep the index true.
